registration_notes.N101.1: RE-SCOPE (registered before measurement, plan execution log): the original matched-cost cell (5,677 atoms, width 119,217) needs a 113.7 GB Gram for the sealed ridge fit (63 GB installed), and both exact subspace surrogates were REFUTED on the sealed codes before dispatch (reduced-rank ridge r=2048 -> 0.030; Lanczos-Galerkin k=200 -> 0.086, vs direct 0.2246). The cell is answered at a width-feasible cost point with everything else unchanged.
registration_notes.N101.2: Matched pair (same ledger equation, widths capped for the sealed Gram fit): b*(729*108 + 729 + 4*345) = a*(729*108 + 729 + 21*345), i.e. b*80,841 = a*86,706 — pool adds counted on BOTH arms (both sum the same 729-activation map). Registered pair: pool b = 2,062, SPM a = 1,923 (SPM width 40,383, pool width 8,248); both ~175.2M MACs/image (delta 0.02%). Both arms share the whitener and are nested prefixes of the seeded [11,100] permutation.
registration_notes.N101.3: Both arms are encoded by the SAME encoder (the SPM encoder's 2x2 level for the pool arm), so the arms differ only in pooling; t1 pins both codepaths at the sealed 6,144 atoms bitwise against the sealed f6144 memmap. Prefix-atom codes are NOT column-comparable to the sealed codes (the triangle activation's mean is over the atom set).
registration_notes.N101.4: t2 is the environment anchor: the direct ridge on the sealed f6144 codes at full data must reproduce Q(6144, 409832) = 0.26136231884058 within 0.002 (context; the gate is the matched-pair head-to-head, not this).
registration_notes.N101.5: t4 is the premise range for the fresh pool encode: Q(2062, 138000) must land within +-0.002 of the sealed atom-ladder envelope [Q(1536,138000)=0.19704347826086957, Q(3072,138000)=0.2152753623188406].
registration_notes.N101.6: Gate: Q_SPM(1923, 409832) >= Q_pool(2062, 409832) + 0.005 at the sealed head constant (penalty 1.0), both on the full 409,832-row schedule, scored on the sealed 34,500-row test. The ridge ladder {0.1, 1.0, 10.0} is reported for both arms; the trained-head read on the SPM codes is the co-adaptation control; the cell closes as a scoped negative only if BOTH the gate fires AND the trained-head read fails.
